--- a/sympy/simplify/trigsimp.py
+++ b/sympy/simplify/trigsimp.py
@@ -1059,6 +1059,21 @@ def __trigsimp(expr, deep=False):
     except TypeError:
         pass
 
+    # Try rewriting exp to trig if the expression has exp functions
+    if expr.has(exp):
+        try:
+            # Try rewriting to trig form with deep=True to handle nested exponentials
+            new = expr.rewrite(sin, deep=True)
+            # Factor the result to simplify
+            fnew = factor(new)
+            if fnew != new:
+                new = sorted([new, fnew], key=count_ops)[0]
+            # Check if the result is simpler
+            if count_ops(new) < count_ops(expr):
+                expr = new
+        except (TypeError, AttributeError):
+            pass
+
     return expr
 #------------------- end of old trigsimp routines --------------------
